title: The Headphones from Mars
content:
Lena was working in a space station when she found a strange pair of headphones.

—What are these? —she asked.

She put them on and heard a strange voice.

—Hello, Lena. Can you hear me?

Lena was surprised.

—Yes, I can! Who are you?

—I am Nova. I am a robot on Mars.

Lena looked at the headphones.

—Can it really talk to me?

—Yes. I can send messages through them.

Lena smiled.

—Can you see me?

—No, I can't. But I can hear you.

Lena looked through the station window.

—We are very far from Earth.

—Yes, but we can still talk.

Lena smiled.

—Then you are my new friend.

Nova answered:

—And you are mine.
